en.headline: sogeisetsu pushes daily report feature; openchamber opens 3 issues
en.summary: sogeisetsu pushed 3 commits to sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu: added a daily GitHub activity report feature using Pages and SenseNova AI, extended the CI workflow to support manual date input via workflow_dispatch, and fixed report submission and page issues. In openchamber/openchamber, three issues were opened: #4337 reported that multi-run docs still reference a sidebar header button removed in d9fbf6b (moved to the composer); #4345 noted that the command palette 'Parallel run' shares the checkbox-multiple icon with the sidebar 'Select sessions'; and #4346 flagged that SidebarHeader.test.tsx still passes after onOpenMultiRun/canOpenMultiRun were removed in d9fbf6b. openchamber-bot[bot] replied on #4337 and #4345 with fix-ready analysis tracing the root causes. Issue #4337 was closed by btriapitsyn.

zh.headline: sogeisetsu 提交日报功能更新，openchamber 新增 3 个 issue
zh.summary: sogeisetsu 向 sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu 推送了 3 个提交：新增基于 Pages 和商汤 AI 的每日 GitHub 活动日报功能，扩展 CI 工作流以支持通过 workflow_dispatch 手动指定日期，并修正了日报提交口径与页面问题。在 openchamber/openchamber 中，共打开了 3 个 issue：#4337 指出多运行文档仍指向 d9fbf6b 中已移除的侧边栏头部按钮（已移至 composer）；#4345 反映命令面板的 Parallel run 与侧边栏 Select sessions 共用 checkbox-multiple 图标；#4346 指出 SidebarHeader.test.tsx 在 onOpenMultiRun/canOpenMultiRun 于 d9fbf6b 中被移除后仍然通过。openchamber-bot[bot] 在 #4337 和 #4345 上回复了 fix-ready 分析，追溯了根因。Issue #4337 由 btriapitsyn 关闭。
